floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 10 reconfirmed (build 107 vs target 108); mapped 2 coupled gaps (A=folded else recompute, B=tail base-copy) and PROVED Gap A's insn is pure-C-reachable via arm-split (107->108), residual

Structural session: both gaps nailed at RTL (Gap A = cse deletion of the else recompute; Gap B = local_alloc live-range split of the join-block base). Clean structural levers (param types, A+B couplin

Structural modality exhausted for both gaps; both residuals proven RA/scheduling coin-flips (Gap B = which callee-save gets the caller-save copy; Gap A = recompute launch priority) -> directed-permute

frontier.hypothesis: A directed permuter run over the whole function (fresh-seed, clean single-function target.o) finds a pure-C spelling that flips the Gap-B callee->caller copy choice (base s1->v0, store s2 directly) and/or anchors the Gap-A recompute last.
frontier.mechanism: both residuals are RA/scheduling ties; the permuter's structural mutations explore orderings/spellings (incl. the (HI)s2 cse materialization and the local-alloc copy choice) outside the hand-search space.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean target.o from asm/funcs/func_80045878.s + tools/decomp-permuter/prelude.inc (drop `.set gp=64` for r3000); run permuter_campaign.py with --stop-on-zero and fresh-seed discipline; harvest+stop in-turn; vet any closing form against the cheat catalog (the (HI)s2/base-copy region is RA, so a legitimate close must be a real value/order spelling, not a dead-value pressure hack).

frontier.hypothesis: Gap A (worth ~1: 10->9 alone) closes by anchoring the arm-split else recompute LAST via lowering its sched1 launch priority (structurally shorten its downstream critical path to the next call arg).
frontier.mechanism: sched1 hoists the recompute because s3 feeds the immediately-following func_8004574C(s3) call arg; a C shape where s3's first post-else use is not a high-latency call would drop its priority so the two else stores schedule first.
frontier.next_probe: From the arm-split base, restructure the first tail statement `if (func_8004574C(s3) != 0)` so s3's first use is delayed/decoupled (e.g. an intervening independent computation the target also has), then re-measure else-block placement; treat as a permuter PERM_ ordering sweep if hand forms don't anchor it.

frontier.hypothesis: Gap B closes by presenting a0 to the three tail stores so cse does NOT materialize the shared (HI)s2 temp (keeping s2 live and stored directly), which is the precondition for the target's base-copy allocation.
frontier.mechanism: eliminating greg insn 213 makes the a0 stores `sh s2` direct; the remaining divergence is only the s1-vs-v0 base register, a narrower local-alloc split.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep spellings that stop the (subreg:HI s2) CSE without dead values (e.g. distinct-provenance a0 reads that survive cse, or a permuter PERM_ over the a0-store value expressions); measure whether `move v0,s2` disappears and count the residual base-register diffs.
